raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Thickness of the topology-optimization continuum",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 2.1 and 4.1 assign 1 cm thickness explicitly for size optimization, but do not specify the topology-analysis thickness. Thickness only scales compliance in a 2D membrane model, but can affect layout in the possible 3D solid interpretation.",
      "readings": [
        "t = 1 mm, using unit thickness in an N-mm model",
        "t = 10 mm, carrying over the thickness assigned for size optimization"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Continuum element family and dimensionality",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Sec. 1.3.1 specifies structured-grid linear hexahedra, whereas Sec. 4.1 describes the same cantilever using 150 × 52 × 1 linear quadrilateral elements.",
      "readings": [
        "150 × 52 four-node bilinear quadrilaterals in 2D",
        "150 × 52 × 1 eight-node trilinear hexahedra in 3D"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "other",
      "entity": "Constitutive idealization for a 2D continuum",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "For the quadrilateral interpretation, neither Sec. 1.3.1 nor the cantilever descriptions specify plane stress or plane strain.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress",
        "Plane strain"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Element integration and stabilization",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 1.3.1 and 4.1 identify linear elements without specifying their integration rule or stabilization.",
      "readings": [
        "Full Gauss integration: 2 × 2 points for quadrilaterals or 2 × 2 × 2 for hexahedra",
        "One-point reduced integration with hourglass stabilization"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "100 kN point force on the free end",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Secs. 2.1 and 4.1 state the magnitude and in-plane position but no force direction or components. Recovering the intended arrow requires the unavailable problem diagram.",
      "readings": [
        "Vertical downward in the plate plane",
        "Horizontal along the cantilever span",
        "In-plane at 45 degrees downward to the span"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "Through-thickness position of the point force if hexahedra are intended",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The 18 cm offset specifies only an in-plane coordinate. Under the 3D interpretation of Sec. 1.3.1, no through-thickness coordinate is supplied.",
      "readings": [
        "At the mid-plane, z = t/2",
        "On one broad face, z = 0",
        "On the opposite broad face, z = t"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "Prescribed solid cells near supports and the load",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 2.1 gives no passive-density mask. Tagging in Secs. 2.2.4 and 4.1 protects pixels during subsequent processing, but does not establish whether support or load cells were also fixed solid during topology optimization.",
      "readings": [
        "No passive cells; tagging starts after topology optimization",
        "Only cells incident to the loaded node are fixed at density 1",
        "A one-element-wide strip along the fixed edge and cells incident to the loaded node are fixed at density 1"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Units and normalization of filter radius R = 1.2",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "The Fig. 2 caption gives R = 1.2 without units. Eq. (7) does not establish whether center distances use element-index coordinates or physical coordinates.",
      "readings": [
        "R = 1.2 element widths, equivalent to 12 mm on the reported in-plane grid",
        "R = 1.2 mm in an N-mm coordinate system"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Density-filter forward operation",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Eq. (6) places rho_i inside the sum over j, so its numerator cancels its denominator and the filter is the identity. The surrounding prose and Eq. (12) instead describe neighboring-density averaging.",
      "readings": [
        "Implement Eq. (6) literally: filtered density equals the original density",
        "Replace rho_i in the numerator by rho_j and use normalized neighboring-density averaging"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "SIMP sensitivity after density filtering",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Sec. 1.3.1 says filtered densities replace design densities, but Eqs. (11) and (13) retain an unfiltered rho_j^(p-1) sensitivity factor. The text does not clarify whether this is shorthand or the implemented expression.",
      "readings": [
        "Evaluate both stiffness and its SIMP derivative at filtered density, then apply the filter chain rule",
        "Evaluate stiffness at filtered density but retain the unfiltered density in the printed sensitivity factor"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Topology optimizer and density-update controls",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No topology-optimization update algorithm, move limit, damping, or asymptote settings are stated. MMA and SQP in Secs. 2.4 and 4.1 concern subsequent frame optimization.",
      "readings": [
        "Optimality criteria with density move limit 0.2 and square-root update",
        "Optimality criteria with density move limit 0.05 and square-root update",
        "MMA with density move limit 0.2 and initial asymptote half-width 0.5",
        "SQP with bound-constrained line-search updates"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Initial topology density field",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Neither Sec. 2.1 nor Sec. 4.1 specifies the initial continuum densities. The stated initial member areas belong to the later frame stage.",
      "readings": [
        "Initialize every free design density to the target volume fraction",
        "Initialize every free design density to 1",
        "Initialize every free design density to 0.5 for all three Fig. 2 runs"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Topology-optimization stopping criterion",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Fig. 2 specifies a maximum of 200 iterations but no early-stopping test or tolerance. The tolerances supplied later are explicitly for size and layout optimization.",
      "readings": [
        "Run exactly 200 optimization iterations",
        "Stop when the maximum density change is below 0.01, or at 200 iterations",
        "Stop when relative compliance change is below 1e-4, or at 200 iterations"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    }
  ]
}
